ghqRoot.description: Fixed GHQ root path. When set, vde-tmux-manager will not call `ghq root`.

sessionManager.description: Settings for the interactive tmux session manager.

enabled.description: Open the session manager in a tmux popup when running inside tmux.

width.description: Popup width as a number or percentage string.

height.description: Popup height as a number or percentage string.

previewWidth.description: Preview width as a number or percentage string.

sessionCaptureLines.description: Fallback number of lines captured for session previews.

paneCaptureLines.description: Fallback number of lines captured for pane previews.

sendCtrlC.description: Send Ctrl-C before TERM/KILL when cleaning up tmux targets.

statuslineCategory.description: Rendering options for the tmux statusline category segment.

mode.description: `current` renders only the active category. `list` renders all categories horizontally and highlights the active one.

format.description: Template for the category label. `{category}` is replaced with the statusline display name.

prefix.description: Optional text rendered before the category body.

suffix.description: Optional text rendered after the category body.

bold.description: Whether the category body is rendered bold.

fg.description: Foreground color for the category body.

bg.description: Background color for the category body.

outerBg.description: Background color outside the body, used behind prefix and suffix.

fg.description: Foreground color for inactive category items in `list` mode.

bg.description: Background color for inactive category items in `list` mode.

outerBg.description: Outside background color for inactive category items in `list` mode.

statuslineSessions.description: Rendering options for the tmux statusline session segment.

format.description: Template for the current session. `{session}` is replaced with the rendered session label.

prefix.description: Optional text rendered before the current session body.

suffix.description: Optional text rendered after the current session body.

bold.description: Whether the current session body is rendered bold.

fg.description: Foreground color for the current session body.

bg.description: Background color for the current session body.

outerBg.description: Background color outside the body, used behind prefix and suffix.

format.description: Template for non-current sessions. `{session}` is replaced with the rendered session label.

prefix.description: Optional text rendered before the non-current session body.

suffix.description: Optional text rendered after the non-current session body.

bold.description: Whether the non-current session body is rendered bold.

fg.description: Foreground color for the non-current session body.

bg.description: Background color for the non-current session body.

outerBg.description: Background color outside the body, used behind prefix and suffix.

categories.description: Category rules used to group tmux sessions by project path or session name.

defaultCategory.description: Fallback category when no override, path rule, or session name rule matches. Empty string means an unnamed category.

displayNames.description: Optional statusline labels keyed by internal category name.

order.description: Optional category ordering. Keys are category names and values are integers used by `vtm category next|prev`.

rules.description: Path-based rules evaluated from top to bottom. First match wins.

category.description: Category name applied when this rule matches.

ghqPatterns.description: Glob patterns matched against a GHQ-root-relative path such as github.com/org/repo. `${VAR_NAME}` is expanded from the environment at config load time.

pathPatterns.description: Glob patterns matched against an absolute normalized path. `~` is expanded to HOME before matching, and `${VAR_NAME}` is expanded from the environment at config load time.

sessionNameRules.description: Exception rules evaluated from top to bottom when path-based matching did not apply.

category.description: Category name applied when the session name matches.

patterns.description: Glob patterns matched against the tmux session name.
